question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage indicates that **Mrs. Reed occasionally visits the room to review its contents.**
 
• The **reflexive pronoun** used should match the subject** "Mrs. Reed."**
 
• The **appropriate word** should signify that Mrs. Reed is performing the action** herself,** without help from others.
 
• "**Herself**" fits well as it refers back to Mrs. Reed, emphasizing that she alone is visiting the room

Therefore, the correct sentence should read **"****Reed herself__, at far intervals, visited it to review its contents."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("oneself", "ourselves", "themselves") do not fit the context as they do not refer to Mrs. Reed specifically.

 
• **Oneself** (स्वयं): "Oneself" is a general reflexive pronoun that does not specifically refer to Mrs. Reed, the subject in this context.
 
• **Ourselves **(हम स्वयं): "Ourselves" is a plural reflexive pronoun, which does not fit as Mrs. Reed is a single individual.
 
• **Themselves** (वे स्वयं): "Themselves" is a reflexive pronoun for multiple subjects, which is not relevant here as the sentence is referring to a single individual, Mrs. Reed.
